comment: Batch 2026-11-11-aqueous-solvents, W6: ethanol in the main data (icheme:chemsep_ethanol), the ethanol entry and form of selection-aqueous-pilot.json with its revisions; its pairs are derived (MaterialCatalog derived pairs), so no pair library is written. Heat data: selection-thermochemistry-ethanol.json (insert-subrecord.mjs), then heating-values.mjs.

homomorph.source: The hydrocarbon homomorph of ethanol: its OH read as CH3 (CH3-CH2-OH as CH3-CH2-CH3). A gas without modified UNIFAC groups takes the E-PPR78 k_ij(T) it has with propane, on propane's own Tc, Pc and acentric factor (tools/aqueous-solvents/gas-in-organics.mjs: N2, CH4, CO2 in ethanol at 25 C within 0.85 to 0.93 of the measured solubility).
